The camera advances alongside the walking couple, maintaining their centered position and nearly constant apparent size.

caption: The video captures a man and a woman seen from behind, walking hand-in-hand across a wet, golden-hour beach. The man on the left wears a white shirt and khaki shorts, the woman on the right a flowing white sundress, their joined hands swinging gently between them. Their legs cycle in a steady walking gait, heels lifting off the sand and feet swinging forward to plant again as their torsos bob slightly. Small waves break to the left, the wet sand ahead mirrors the pale sky, and a curved tongue of dry sand bounds the right. Long parallel shadows stretch across the beach toward the right, and a low hazy island rests on the horizon. Faint footprints trail in the wet sand in the foreground. The couple remain centered and side by side at a nearly constant apparent size, so the view advances along with them rather than watching them recede. The walking is already underway and continues throughout.
